function.name: lookup_software_component
function.description: Retrieves the architectural specification, ports, interfaces, and runnables for a named AUTOSAR Software Component.

swc_name.description: Name of the SWC (e.g., SWC_ExteriorLighting, SWC_WiperControl, SWC_CameraPerception)

function.name: verify_port_connections
function.description: Checks whether a required port (R-Port) has a matching providing port (P-Port) with identical interface and datatype across the VFB.

port_name.description: Name of the port to verify (e.g., R_VehicleSpeed, R_HazardLightCmd)

function.name: compare_hld_revisions
function.description: Executes structural diff comparison between two HLD document baselines to detect added, modified, or removed components and interfaces.
